prompts.prompt: Original high quality HD game environment BACKGROUND ONLY for an immersive minimal character creator, wide 16:9 single full-bleed image. Obsidian Holodeck prototype-world aesthetic: a vast empty simulation space, coherent realistic material and atmospheric depth, elegant restrained fine square material seams, smooth quiet ground, absolutely no architecture or props. Dark Obsidian: #111317 charcoal vast chamber, graphite floor, restrained muted bronze seams #C9A66B at very low brightness, smoky neutral diffuse atmospheric depth. Dark foreground, readable softly lit midground, calm near-black upper volume. Rich but restrained tonal depth; no neon, no golden glow. A low three-quarter camera for a standing pixel character creator. One uninterrupted floor recedes to a delicate blurred horizon at 32 percent image height. Ground at central standing area near 74 percent image height. A very broad soft distant light falloff gives massive spatial depth, without a bright stripe. This is a reusable clean environment plate. No character, humanoid, silhouettes, equipment, shadow of any actor, contact shadow, reflection of any person, text, UI, labels, frame, border, particles, icons, emblems, sun, clouds, debris, or control console. Keep central ground quiet for small crisp source sprites, and left/right space calm for floating UI. Beautiful immersive expansive space, not a flat gradient wallpaper. Do not draw any standing platform or spotlight circle.
